ref.quote: Het betreft de verschuldigde dotaties in toepassing van het artikel 58duodecies van de wet van 31 december 1983 tot hervorming der instellingen voor de Duitstalige Gemeenschap. [...] dotatie gezinsbijslagen [...] dotatie ouderenzorg [...] dotatie gezondheidszorgen & hulp aan personen [...] dotatie ziekenhuizen
ref.note: A grant to another government, not federal spending on a service. The amount follows from the law of 31 December 1983 (art. 58duodecies) and its parameters (population, index, growth); changing it means changing that law, and the German-speaking Community, not the federal government, decides how the money is spent. The dotation also covers houses of justice (justitiehuizen) and extra means for the Community's small scale; the line also includes hospital investments paid on the Community's behalf, the senator grant and prison prefinancing. Phrases describe what the transferred competences are; they are not a prediction of the Community's choices. Second check: phrases now say 'a smaller/larger grant for' rather than 'less/more money for' child benefit, elderly care and hospitals, because the Community, not the federal budget, sets child benefit and care spending; 'hospitals' narrowed to 'hospital investments' (division 36 p. 41 and the 'dotatie ziekenhuizen' are for hospital infrastructure and medico-technical services). 'the Community' refers to the line label. corrected: rephrased all six phrases from 'less/more money for X in the German-speaking Community' to 'a smaller/larger grant for the Community's X', so they describe the transfer (fixed by art. 58duodecies of the law of 31 December 1983) and not the Community's own spending decisions; 'hospitals' narrowed to 'hospital investments' as the source describes; shortened to about 8 words. Quote and locator confirmed verbatim (DOC 56 1281/001 p. 27 and table p. 31).
